svg.desc: 13,956 GitHub contributions across 138 active days, 2025-10-12 to 2026-10-14. Contributions fund homes and connecting lanes. Active weeks earn festivals. When real public activity context is available, the civic square reports observed sampled commits, issues, pull requests and reviews without inventing daily attribution.
